column1: # Follow-up probes for task lifetimes, Sleep and module constants (#724): what OpenVerse prints is in each probe's header and in note; the Book's expectation where it has one; Epic's outcome and lines in epic_outcome and epic_lines (UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086, Use Verse VM, newVerseVm=true, 2026-11-19; - where not yet run), its error and the comparison in note. One difference found, now fixed: branch-cancel-order (a cancelled task stops its children before its own defers run); the cancel-* and end-* probes ask how that rule extends.

column7: note

Same. Run alone (single mode): begin|main returning|end|branch cleanup, no branch tick in the 12 s after: the branch, a child of the device's OnBegin task, is stopped when OnBegin ends. OpenVerse: main returning|branch cleanup (stopped when Main, the entry, ends).
